fetch_failure.title: SolArk: data fetch failing
fetch_failure.description:
Home Assistant has been unable to fetch {component} from the SolArk cloud for over an hour. The affected sensors are showing stale or unknown values.

Things to check:
1. Internet connectivity from Home Assistant.
2. SolArk cloud status (try logging in at www.solarkcloud.com).
3. The integration may need re-authentication (Settings > Devices & Services > SolArk).
4. Look for `custom_components.solark` warnings in Settings > System > Logs.

This issue will clear automatically once data starts flowing again.
